item.title: [github_trending] vectorize-io/hindsight
item.description: Hindsight is an open-source agent-memory project from vectorize-io, pitched as memory that learns. It ships a Python package (hindsight-api), an npm client, docs, a cookbook, a benchmark site and an arXiv paper (2512.12818), plus a hosted Hindsight Cloud. Developers who want a persistent memory layer for agents without building one from scratch can check its benchmarks first.

Developers weighing the two tools, or wondering what agent-style coding feels like day to day, are the audience.

item.title: [infoq] htmx 4.0 发布：改用 Fetch API 重写，内置 DOM Morphing Swap，并明确属性继承规则
item.description: htmx 4.0.0 is out — the team skipped 3.0 entirely, replacing XMLHttpRequest with the native fetch() API while keeping the script near 14KB and adding streaming support. It ships built-in Morphing Swap via idiomorph and an hx-partial tag, but attribute inheritance is now opt-in: parent attributes only reach children with an :inherited suffix, so patterns like hx-headers silently break with 403s. It's published under npm's next tag, not latest.

item.title: [github_trending] cs341-illinois/coursebook
item.description: This repository hosts the open-source introductory systems programming textbook used by CS 341: System Programming at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. Its README notes it assumes a prior programming-language course and ships the material as PDF, HTML, EPUB and a wiki. It's a free, directly usable resource for developers who want structured practice with systems programming in C.

item.title: [github_trending] NawfalMotii79/PLFM_RADAR
item.description: NawfalMotii79/PLFM_RADAR, also named AERIS-10, is an open-source pulse linear frequency modulated (PLFM) phased array radar built around a low-cost 10.5 GHz design. The hardware is released under CERN-OHL-P and the software under MIT, and the project is still at Alpha with features marked work in progress. It targets hardware builders who want to assemble a radar and learn phased-array and FMCW signal processing hands-on.
